q: SI solved trafficking FIR but court asks why remand collapsed. Backward audit shows late production and no women safeguard note. Fix?
options: Produce in time, record night safeguard compliance and medical care link
expl: Reverse-engineer shows procedure kills substance. Timelines save case.
why: Analytical audit starts from collapse. New-code timelines and safeguards are proof, not paper.

q: Note says Directives override rights so quota can ignore caps and minority shield. Error type?
options: Half-truth, Directives guide but rights and caps and shield remain
expl: Half-truth inflates Directives. Balance keeps enforceability.
why: Strong analysis spots overread. Guidance cannot erase ceilings and exclusions.

q: Free speech rally vs public order vs minority school prayer nearby. All claim absolute win. Resolve?
options: Balance by listed limits, consent rule and no identity denial together
expl: Collision needs joint balancing, not single winner.
why: Cross-article crash demands filters. Order, consent and admission guard run together.

q: If SI delays rescue, traffickers shift districts, child loses school year, family alleges detention. Chain?
options: Evidence lost, welfare lost, production and duty pleas multiply
expl: Chain reaction spreads across crime, welfare and remedies.
why: Delay is compounder. Early action breaks movement, loss and litigation spiral.

q: Long set on Preamble, equality, arrest, tax, schools looks perfect but says State can limit forces rights. Verdict?
options: Fails, forces curb needs Parliament alone
expl: Everything-correct hides source trap. Exclusivity decides.
why: Analytical sweep must distrust polish. One source error sinks set.

q: After 2023 codes, what replaces old trafficking sections in FIR and what night protection must SI note for women?
options: Cite new trafficking provision, ensure witness and safeguard compliance
expl: BNS-BNSS 2023-24 govern trafficking and night-arrest guard.
why: Current-affairs accuracy matters. FIR must speak new law with safeguard memo.

q: With 26 districts in AP since 2022, a rescue needs shelter in another district. Best coordination?
options: Zero-FIR, alert concerned SP and child panel, escort with memo
expl: 26-district map needs zero-FIR and panel handoff.
why: Reorganisation tests teamwork. Jurisdiction follows victim, not map pride.

q: Nov 2022 EWS verdict is cited to force quota in minority unaided college. Correct use?
options: Verdict upheld EWS but special quota clause keeps minorities out
expl: Janhit Abhiyan Nov 2022 validity coexists with minority exclusion.
why: Current fact must be fenced. General upholding does not swallow special shield.

q: 2024 nine-judge Directive reading is cited to claim all private schools can be taken over. Caution?
options: Reading is context-specific, minority establish-administer survives, no blanket takeover
expl: 2024 39(b) ruling is broad but not blanket nationalisation.
why: Current trap stretches ratio. Specific holding cannot erase school shield.

q: 106th Amendment 2023 is cited to claim immediate one-third posts for women in police stations. Reply?
options: Operative after census and delimitation for legislatures, not immediate station quota
expl: 106th Amendment waits on census-delimitation, legislature seats.
why: Timing plus scope trap. Do not convert seat reservation into station quota.
